WELCOME TO THE FIELD

A little land.
A real challenge.

Survey the four remaining corners of a five-sided lot, then turn your readings into a boundary map.

  1. Set up at P1. The north-facing P2 marker is your reference direction (0°).
  2. Sight P2–P5. Drag to aim the crosshair at each red-and-white pole. Record its angle and horizontal distance.
  3. Plot your points. Open the notebook. Use your readings to place each corner, then check your survey.

Phone: left thumb to walk, drag the scene to look. Landscape gives you more room. Computer: WASD and drag, or arrow keys to aim.

A practice activity inspired by Surveying requirements 2–3. This simplified simulation supports learning; it does not replace the badge’s fieldwork, protractor-and-scale map, or counselor review.
